note: Research proposal prepared from official documentation on 2026-11-08. All boundaries and tiers require human confirmation; no approval, authorship or review is asserted.

cli.label: Antigravity CLI (agy)
cli.interface_and_execution_location: Terminal TUI and headless print mode on the developer workstation; model inference is a hosted service (the docs describe the CLI talking to a shared agent harness and model endpoints).

version.documentation_note: Official pages accessed 2026-11-08, identified by converted-text and raw HTML hashes. Claims are not attributed to an installed or benchmarked binary.

modes: Interactive current documented execution modes, with mode-specific permission distinctions
Headless print mode with explicit permissions and timeout scope
cli.account_and_tier: Proposed: Individual personal Google account without Google AI Pro/Ultra; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
cli.model_support: Gemini models listed by `agy models`; some models require paid plans (FAQ). Model choice is not part of the comparison.
included_components: Native CLI tools, permissions engine, rules, skills, hooks, MCP client, subagents, /plan, /diff, /rewind, /resume, artifact review, headless mode
exclusions: Antigravity App, Antigravity IDE, IDE extensions and SDK (separate surfaces; claims from their sections do not transfer)
Third-party plugins, MCP servers, skills and custom subagents beyond the native mechanisms (the mechanism is assessed; no add-on is added to the profile)
Gemini Enterprise administrative controls (VPC-SC, data residency, Cloud logging) unless the team selects the enterprise tier
cli.instructions_and_permissions: Current interactive default-mode diff review, separate execution and tool-permission settings, and optional terminal sandbox. No newer behavior is attributed to the old active 1.4.0 binary profile.

app.label: Antigravity App - Windows native baseline (proposed)
app.interface_and_execution_location: Interactive standalone desktop App with local Windows project folders. Do not infer local model processing from local file execution.

version.documentation_note: Official pages accessed 2026-11-08, identified by converted-text and raw HTML hashes. Claims are not attributed to an installed or benchmarked binary.

modes: Interactive implementation planning and direct execution; document mode-specific conditions
Local project work; native terminal actions and artifact review
platforms: Windows 11 24H2 or later with the August 2026 update or later where the documented terminal sandbox applies; updated versus previous permission settings remain a review question
app.account_and_tier: Proposed: Individual personal Google account without Google AI Pro/Ultra; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
app.model_support: Document compatible models and account restrictions without selecting a model for execution; this assessment makes no evaluated-tool or model calls.
included_components: Native App project context, editing, planning, artifact review, terminal actions and permission mechanisms
Assess native support for rules, skills and MCP without adding third-party packages or connections
exclusions: Antigravity CLI, standalone IDE, editor extensions and SDK
Added MCP servers, marketplace plugins, user-authored skills, Spec Kit and custom orchestration
Benchmark results, screenshots and empirical feature tests as evidence
app.instructions_and_permissions: Assess rules and App permission/review mechanisms from official documentation. Distinguish updated and previous permission systems, platform/account eligibility and activation; no runtime preset or enforcement is claimed.
